spec: solar-verify's Counter spec (crates/verify/examples/Counter.sol NatSpec, SolidCore.Refinement.Solar.VerifyCounter.spec), proved of stage0 by holds_stage0
excluded: source: solar's first lowered MIR (stage0) under the oracle with EthLib's caller, Keccak-256 and environment, not SolidCore: no SolidCore stage reaches loops yet (frontend trust boundary at the first lowered MIR)
valid calls: every call whose selector is bump(uint256) (any further call data, any value, any storage); the other functions of the contract are outside this statement

resources: not proved; the cut-point backend stages give the final EVM IR's end, not its block count, so the loop checker's forward theorem has no bound; equivalence admits a failure that changes nothing at any gas
allowed statuses: every status (the spec states success conditions; Outcome of specPost carries what the spec says of reverts)
deployment: the init code is not covered
calls: one frame, caller 0x2000, contract at 0x1000, the block and transaction of Target.message
